room_rent.note: For SI 3L–10L: Single Private AC Room. For SI above 10L: at actuals. Options to downgrade to General Ward, Twin Sharing, or 1%/1.5%/2% of SI per day are available.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals for all SI bands.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. International Cover add-on has mandatory 10% co-pay. OPD lab reimbursement without pre-approval has 20% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Cataract sub-limited; maternity capped by SI band
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 20% of SI max ₹1L/eye for SI ≤10L; actuals for SI >10L. Maternity: ₹50K (SI 5–10L), ₹75K (SI 15–20L), ₹1L (SI >20L); not covered for SI 3–4L. Baby Care: ₹1L (SI ≤4L), ₹5L (SI 5–10L), ₹10L (SI 15–50L), ₹15L (SI >50L). OPD doctor consult sub-limit ₹500 GP/₹1,200 specialist per visit.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Policy supports optional aggregate or per-claim deductible structures per schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Not applicable for accidents or renewals with 12+ months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: Default 36 months. Optional reduction to 1 year, 2 years, or 3 years available. Portability credit applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Default 24 months for 32 listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.). Optional reduction to 1 year, 2 years, or 3 years available.

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait; not covered for SI 3–4L)
maternity.note: Inbuilt for SI ≥5L. Limit: ₹50K (SI 5–10L), ₹75K (SI 15–20L), ₹1L (SI >20L). Includes surrogacy and ART complications. Max 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime. Waiting period reduces by 1 year for long-term policy with upfront premium.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (25%/yr for SI 3–4L; 50%/yr for SI ≥5L)
cumulative_bonus.note: SI 3–4L: 25% per annum, max 100%. SI 5L+: 50% per annum, max 100%. CB reduces at same rate if claim made; SI not reduced.

restoration.note: Available for same illness. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 15-day gap from discharge (gap not required for different insured). Reinstated SI usable for inpatient hospitalisation only.

pre_hosp.note: Options to change: 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 180, 240 days (240 days only for SI ≥5L).

post_hosp.note: Options to change: 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 180, 240 days (240 days only for SI ≥5L).

day_care.display: All day-care (extensive listed + any tech-advance procedure)
day_care.note: 398+ listed procedures plus any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: Must exceed 3 days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, gout, diarrhoea, vector-borne diseases, psychiatric disorders, pyrexia of unknown origin, chronic nephritis.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation ≥24 hrs covered. Comfort treatments (steam bath, oil massage, resort packages) excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for donor covered. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Reinstatement/CB not applicable for this cover.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance to nearest hospital with emergency facilities or transfer to higher facility. Payable only if inpatient or day-care claim accepted.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, HIFU, etc.

consumables.note: Consumable Expenses cover (Annexure IV list: gloves, masks, braces, nebulizer kit, ECG electrodes, etc.) included inbuilt up to inpatient SI.

global_cover.note: International Cover – Emergency Care Only available as optional cover. Covers inpatient hospitalisation outside India for emergencies occurring abroad. 10% mandatory co-pay. Valid 45 days/single trip, 180 days cumulative/year. CB/reinstatement cannot be used.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no look-back applied. Claims contestable only for proven fraud or permanent exclusions thereafter.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly instalment (15 days). Continuity benefits protected if renewed within grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: Apply at least 30 days before renewal, not earlier than 60 days. Accrued waiting period credits transferred per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions: Dental (cosmetic/prosthetic), external medical equipment at home (CPAP, O2 concentrator), congenital external anomalies, growth hormone therapy, infertility/ART (base), change-of-gender, cosmetic surgery, war, terrorism covered
optional_riders: Loss of Income Cover (weekly benefit), Major Illness & Accident Multiplier (indemnity, up to 2x SI for 10 critical illnesses/accidents), International Cover – Emergency Care Only
